scope: Qualified cold final distribution and extracted tests, not a complete single-job fresh-PGO release measurement. Earlier training and transfer/setup overhead not included in production time.
comparability: Each setting matches its first-cohort image, tools, configuration, profiles, 20 output names and qualification counts. CPU model differs between replicas.
conclusion: No demonstrated scheduling speedup. The first CPU-model-matched link1 observation is slower; unchanged baseline host variation is much larger. Do not pool all hosts into a scheduling percentage.

same_cpu_model_link1_vs_baseline.caveat: One VM per setting, different jobs/time and independently trained profiles. CPU-model matched, not same-machine controlled; not proof of a regression.

unchanged_baseline_between_cpu_models.caveat: Same source, configuration, profiles and tools, but different VMs/CPU models. Shows observed host variability, not an isolated causal CPU-model benchmark.
